# Chikoro AI

> Chikoro AI is an educational platform for Zimbabwean students, teachers, and families. It provides curriculum-aligned tutoring for ZIMSEC and Cambridge learners in English, Shona, and Ndebele.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://chikoro-ai.com/): Product overview, supported curricula, languages, subjects, and school offering.
- [About](https://chikoro-ai.com/about): Mission and approach to multilingual AI-supported education.
- [Pricing](https://chikoro-ai.com/pricing): Current individual and school pricing information.
- [Blog](https://chikoro-ai.com/blog): Study guides and Zimbabwe education resources.
